title: Royal Canin India targets 3x growth in 5 years, steps up investment in brand building, distribution and pack.. - ET Retail
summary: Royal Canin India targets 3x growth in 5 years, steps up investment in brand building, distribution and pack.. ET Retail
ai_summary: Royal Canin India aims to triple its growth over five years by increasing investment in brand building, distribution, and packaging. The company plans to strengthen its market presence through these strategic initiatives.
